executive_summary: No further lawful in-scope Planner/Manager stage inside /work/saivage-v3 can advance Stage 000 before operator/environment repair. The previously identified in-scope script defect was already corrected and completed in the script-hardening stage; the remaining blockers are external prerequisites (Node version, /work/tmp writability, /work/saivage-e2e-checkers restoration/Playwright readiness) plus Saivage TaskReport serialization, and repeated probes now only reproduce the same failures.

questions.question: 1. Given completed script-hardening and repeated prerequisite probes, is there any remaining lawful in-scope corrective stage inside /work/saivage-v3 that can advance S00 without operator fixes?
questions.answer: No. The only previously identified in-scope corrective work was PLAN script hardening, and it is already completed in stage 000-breakage-detection-harness-script-hardening with commits 690b94cc7d136df079130262012f1f5f3dcfc640 and 556768aa532375031927378eaa3c5d5aa38fb605. Its summary records that run-gates.sh now emits deterministic unknown-failure ids for blocked web-vitest and analyst-e2e aborts, and validate-baseline.sh now rejects nonzero observed_exit_code gates instead of accepting observed_exit_code=1 with empty failing_ids. The later final-environment-retry and prereq-reprobe summaries show no product-code or immutable stage-doc diffs and stopped before baseline regeneration because mandatory external prerequisites still failed. Under the stated scope boundary, Planner/Manager may not repair /work/tmp permissions, create/restore /work/saivage-e2e-checkers, change the Node runtime, touch /opt/service controls, or fix Saivage TaskReport serialization as a Stage 000 product/PLAN artifact task. Therefore another in-scope stage would not advance S00; it would only restate blockers.

questions.question: 2. Would further re-probing be useful, or would it only repeat the same external blockers until the operator changes Node, /work/tmp, /work/saivage-e2e-checkers, and TaskReport serialization?
questions.answer: Further re-probing is not useful until there is evidence of operator/environment change. Plan history records the sequence: initial S00 failed, retry-after-jq-fix escalated, script-hardening completed, final-environment-retry escalated, and prereq-reprobe escalated. The two post-hardening prerequisite probes report the same hard blockers: Node v24.15.0 while package engines require >=22.12.0 <23; /work/tmp cannot be created/written due Permission denied; /work/saivage-e2e-checkers is absent with package.json/node_modules/Playwright readiness unavailable; and Coder/Reviewer TaskReport serialization still returns schema_mismatch. Repeating the probe without an operator change would consume another stage and likely produce identical evidence. The useful next probe is conditional: run it only after the operator confirms Node 22.x, writable /work/tmp, restored e2e checker workspace/deps/browsers, and repaired TaskReport serialization.

questions.question: 3. What should the Planner keep queued, if anything, while waiting for operator/environment repair under the always-take-action constraint?
questions.answer: Keep no executable corrective implementation stage queued against /work/saivage-v3 while the blockers remain unchanged; current plan.json already has current_stage_id null and stages empty, which is the correct hold posture. Under always-take-action, the lawful action is a standing operator-wait/conditional retry item rather than another Manager stage: document the exact operator prerequisites and queue a single conditional S00 retry only after an operator/environment-change signal is received. That retry should first run a bounded non-secret prerequisite probe; if the probe passes, regenerate baseline-gates.json with run-gates.sh --baseline, run authoritative V.1-V.11 through the published driver, obtain/record clean review evidence after TaskReport serialization is fixed, and perform zero-NEW breakage triage. If the probe still fails, stop immediately and report without running baseline regeneration.

questions.question: 4. Can Stage 000 be marked complete, or must it remain blocked until authoritative V.1-V.11 and zero-NEW breakage triage pass?
questions.answer: Stage 000 cannot be marked complete. The completed script-hardening stage only fixed false-green behavior in the harness; it did not satisfy Stage 000 close acceptance. The post-hardening summaries explicitly say baseline regeneration and V.1-V.11 were not run because mandatory prerequisites failed. Stage 000 must remain blocked until all four baseline gates run end-to-end in the repaired environment, baseline-gates.json is regenerated only after successful end-to-end execution, validate-baseline.sh and run-gates.sh --diff pass authoritatively, V.1-V.11 pass, a clean reviewer/quality gate is available or otherwise explicitly authorized, and breakage triage records zero NEW failures with ledger handling per protocol.
